# Next Adventure

> > Portland's outdoor gear retailer founded by Deek and Bryan, serving the Pacific Northwest with hiking, camping, and kayaking equipment across locations in Portland and Sandy, Oregon.

Next Adventure operates outdoor retail stores in SE Portland and Sandy, Oregon, specializing in new and used outdoor gear with a focus on hiking, camping, backpacking, and water sports. The company is known for its Bargain Basement used gear section and community-focused approach to outdoor retail in the Pacific Northwest.
